name: Billow AI Labs
long_description:
Billow handles the work of Accounting and FP&A FTEs keeping teams compliant and audit-ready. We work within existing stacks (NetSuite, Coupa, and 80+ other systems) and complex spreadsheets, chasing down information and coordinating approvals across stakeholders. 

Built by repeat founders; Joan built and exited an accounting/ERP platform (45,000 businesses in 4 years) and Phil built Bloomberg's financial “brain” data infrastructure, and as CTO of a trading platform ($1B in volume). Advisors include CFOs, controllers, auditors from publicly-traded biopharma, and a Big-4 Accounting firm.

launches.title: Billow - Killing Deloitte with AI
launches.body:
# **_We’re killing Deloitte with AI_**

[https://drive.google.com/file/d/1YaUyJE-ZL0poxDAFGv962RniFsue5nyE](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1YaUyJE-ZL0poxDAFGv962RniFsue5nyE/view?usp=sharing)

**Accounting is a $700B industry that hasn’t changed in 200 years.** Today, 80% of companies still do their accounting by hand – manually exporting data, building spreadsheets, and chasing approvals.

**Billow is an accounting firm that replaces human accountants with AI agents.**

We connect to your existing tools (NetSuite, QuickBooks, and 80+ other systems) and use agents to provide faster, cheaper, and better accounting services. 

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=110394&key=user_uploads/983067/43e1b7ba-2178-44e3-a001-690ad7b41766)

There is zero software for customers to use. Just integrate and we’ll close your books for you.

In the last three months, we went from an idea to partnering with Series B-D companies representing over $1B in enterprise value.

**Team:**

* [Joanathan McIntosh](https://www.linkedin.com/in/joanathanlim/) - Repeat VC-backed founder, built and exited an accounting/ERP platform (45k businesses in 4 years). Ex-Merrill Lynch and StreetLight Data (AI/ML for US Government)
* [Philip Moniaga](https://www.linkedin.com/in/philipmoniaga/) - Repeat YC founder (W22). Built financial infra at Bloomberg and [Booking.com](http://Booking.com). CTO of a trading platform ($1B+ in volume).

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=110394&key=user_uploads/983067/0bf2a219-f426-444c-a7c2-dda2bbd7e6e7)

**Ask - intros to:**

* CFOs, Controllers, and VPs of Finance at companies with $40M+ in revenue or funding.
* Fractional CFOs, accounting and advisory firms
* **$5k referral or 1 US Open ticket for every closed customer.**

[joan@thebillow.ai](mailto:joan@thebillow.ai) | [thebillow.ai](http://thebillow.ai)
